description: This file is a JavaScript module script responsible for post-build steps in a runtime environment. It manages copying static assets, staging plugin dependencies, generating alias files, and orchestrating these tasks into a runRuntimePostBuild function, which is invoked if the script is run directly.

methods.name: listStaticExtensionAssetOutputs
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of destination paths for static extension assets based on the configured assets array or default static assets.

methods.name: copyStaticExtensionAssets
methods.description: Copies static extension assets from source to destination directories, creating directories as needed, and issues warnings if assets are missing.

methods.name: writeStableRootRuntimeAliases
methods.description: Generates alias files in the distribution directory for runtime assets that match a specific filename pattern.

methods.name: runRuntimePostBuild
methods.description: Orchestrates the post-build steps: copying plugin SDK alias, metadata, channel catalog, staging plugin runtime dependencies, generating aliases, and copying static assets.
